stemMd:
Two fair six-sided dice, each labelled 1 through 6, are rolled independently.

Quantity A: Probability their sum is 6

Quantity B: Probability their sum is 7
instructionsMd: Compare the two quantities using only the given information.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The relationship cannot be determined from the information given.

explanationMd: A sum of 6 has five ordered outcomes, while a sum of 7 has six. All 36 ordered outcomes are equally likely, so the second probability is larger.
